title: Inspect extracted inner seed.seco and storage.seco for Q1 contact identity
why: The prior archive route established successful outer extraction in j000190 but left the extracted inner seed.seco and storage.seco contents unread. These are a distinct existing material source that could contain a readable intended-contact clue or a linkage that distinguishes the target from the email sender; their contents have not been used to answer Q1.

routes.method: Inspect the sealed manifest and inner files seed.seco/storage.seco for file types, readable identity strings, and structural relationships to contact records; parse only with trusted offline tools, never execute recovered code. Stop if they are clearly tool artefacts or unrelated; do not infer absence from a negative string search.
